title: Mixed Event — Insatiable Pale Color — Episode2 I'll Show You

meta.Event Outline: While Kanade and the others embrace Nightcord at 25:00's rising popularity, Ena's illustration account remains stagnant. Ena then sets her sights on an art competition...

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <*Yawn*... So sleepy...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Man, the sun's so bright...!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Keep it down, Amia.
It's like you're yelling right into my ear.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Why? You and I are the only ones here anyway, Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And I'm telling you to pipe down!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <*Sigh*... I think I'll log off now. There's only a few minor adjustments left to make so...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then I'll log off after I get a look at it♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No way. Not until it's completely done.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Aww, not even just a tiny little peek? It'll help me with the video if I know what sort of imagery I should be focusing on too, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You say that, but I know you just want to look at it...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Come to think of it, Yuki left at her usual time, but K left pretty early today. I wonder if she had something to do?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, she said it's her day to go to the hospital.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, right... She can only visit during the day.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Why don't you get some sunshine for a change too, Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I am, aren't I?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <No, by actually going outside. You never know, it might feel good.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're one to talk. Plus, aren't you about to go to bed?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yup♪ Staying up late is bad for the skin so...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So I think I'll leave things here. Later, Enanan.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Okay, good night.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll brush my teeth and go to bed too then...
Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Morning...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Morning.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You stayed up all night again?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And what if I did?
Just go to school already, will you?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I doubt a night school student would know, but I still have plenty of time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh? Thanks for the tip, not like I care or anything.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? What's this?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, they're some art exhibit flyers dad brought home. It's just never-ending with him.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know, right? They just keep piling up, so I wish he'd stop bringing them home.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait... This piece is by that artist I like...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Shibuya Art Contest...
This person won last time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Sigh... It must be nice to win something like this...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And this contest is a pretty serious one at that, so I can't possibly...)
Do you want to enter in the contest?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wh-What's it to you...?
It's my choice, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: Yes, it is.

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: But this contest attracts artists that are as good as actual professionals every year.

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: So you don't stand a chance.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What...?! Oh, I get it. I'm too talentless or not worthy of entering into this contest, aren't I?

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: That's not what I'm saying. I just think it'll be difficult to win any of the prizes.

rows.Speaker: Dad
rows.Line: But if that doesn't bother you, then go right on ahead.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh...
se_event_infinitelygray_2021_007

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: H-Hey...!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Won't stand a chance? Can't win anything? What if I can? I won't know unless I try, right?!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I've never entered into any big contests like this before, so I have no idea what's going to happen...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I'm sure to get recognition if I win something!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Even from him...!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's it... I'm gonna win it all in this contest!
Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And the paint is... Oh, here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I know that I decided to make a submission for this contest, but going out to buy supplies after an all-nighter feels...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (No, I don't really have a choice. My old paint is all dried up after not being used for so long.)
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ena...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, Kanade!
What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I was visiting my father.
How about you?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I... Um...
I was getting art supplies.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Art supplies?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wow, you're entering into a contest?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, it's a pretty big one too. Some of the other artists are practically pros too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Really? That sounds cool.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, anyone can submit a piece so it's really nothing...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry. It's just that... I've never been in a contest like this before so I'm just a little worried is all...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You're worried?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I mean... I'm wondering if I can do a good job.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't know much about actual art, but I can tell you this at least...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I like your art, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So please give it your best shot.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank you, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'll do what I can.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm home...
Oh, right. There's no one here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. But I'm happy that I ran into Kanade today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I like your art, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Time to get started!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(And I'll put a shadow in here...
There. Looks good!)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (This motif sort of loses its impact...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I've heard that ambiguity or blurring things on purpose actually loses you points so...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That means I should...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Right, one more try.
I still have time.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This isn't right. It needs to stand out from the rest of the piece more...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It needs to be seen by everyone... It needs to be recognized...!)
